crossRefs.note: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother…
added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

people.name: Galilee

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: John

translations.web: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
translations.bsb: When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee.
translations.kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
translations.asv: Now when he heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee;
